newsitem.title: USA: FinishMaster Q1 net up on cost controls.
newsitem.headline: FinishMaster Q1 net up on cost controls.

text.p: FinishMaster Inc said Thursday new cost control programs contributed to higher earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company, which distributes automotive paints and related accessories, reported net income of $406,000, or $0.07 a share, compared to $2,000, or nil, a year ago.
Sales in the period were $29.2 million, versus $30.0 million in the first quarter of 1996, the company said.
FinishMaster, which said the sales decline stemmed from lower same-outlet sales, also said it will reorganize its sales outlets as of April 30 to include four regional divisions.
The company's shares were up one Thursday at 7.
